rationale: The effective outcome discrepancy_found is confirmed. Luna materially undercounted the current catalog, and the frozen allergen arrays exceed what the restaurant descriptions can establish. Terra correctly preserves many explicit positives and rejects unsupported negatives and cross-contact conclusions, but its product reconciliation duplicates one item, omits three current baseline products, misses valid milk/egg/fish/shellfish/peanut/sesame positives, and over-promotes coconut to tree-nut. The result therefore requires repair before coordinator acceptance.
